verdict.summary: Paroxetine is a strong CYP2D6 inhibitor, and tamoxifen needs CYP2D6 to form its active metabolite, endoxifen. With intermediate metabolizer CYP2D6 status, this combination is documented to lower endoxifen formation.

references.citation: Goetz MP, et al. CPIC Guideline for CYP2D6 and Tamoxifen Therapy.
